propositions: max_consecutive_repeat metric only detects adjacent identical signatures and scores multi-call cycles (k >= 2) as 1, missing real loops while healthy high-novelty runs can score 5+
a synthetic 4-call cycle repeated 31-37x scores max_consecutive_repeat=1, while a healthy 92%-distinct trace scores 5, inverting the signal
proposed windowed distinct-ratio (trailing 24 calls) fires <= 0.50 on pathological traces (bf31 scores 0.167, 46a2 scores 0.04) and stays above 0.833 on healthy runs, creating wide separation margin
distinct_ratio_window field must be None when fewer than REPETITION_WINDOW signatures exist to prevent false positives on short all-identical prefixes
module constants REPETITION_WINDOW=24 and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO=0.50 must be exported and shared across three consumers (usage_log producer, c827 actuator, aec1 recorder)
existing counters and privacy contract (argument hashing) must remain unchanged; new signal is additive to _repetition_summary output
